rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.003, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (one knob vs iter-5 best). NUMBERS n_outer sweep(n_bands6): 0->RMSE0.401, 1->RMSE0.00558/SSIM0.941/PSNR35.74 (NEW BEST, sharp optimum), 2->0.0247, 4->0.114. n_outer=1 (single residual pass) is the clear optimum and SSIM 0.941 already EXCEEDS the FBP baseline SSIM 0.920; RMSE 0.00558 is only 7pct above the 0.00521 baseline -> hr still 0 by a whisker. FAILURE MODE: the single residual add-back slightly OVERSHOOTS -- the densified-residual FBP injects a little streak-noise that keeps RMSE marginally above baseline. wu_soft_thresh gates how much residual is added back (sign*relu(|r|-thresh)); base 0.0015 (light). ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0015 -> 0.003 (heavier, n_outer locked 1). HYPOTHESIS: if I roughly double the soft-threshold, more of the residuals streak-noise is zeroed before add-back, so the corrected recon keeps the genuine structure (SSIM already>baseline) while shedding the noise -> RMSE drops below 0.00521 and hr>0 clears baseline for the first time. Risk: too heavy a thresh also removes genuine residual detail (RMSE back up) -> then optimum thresh is in (0.0015,0.003) and I bisect. Budget: ~seconds.
